name: ARK95X Prime Agent Stack

compute_lanes.description: Use gaming PC/GPU resources as local compute and simulation capacity.
Use trading algorithm patterns for research/backtest and operations scoring only.
Bridge intent into shells and agent CLIs.

symbolic_compression.quantum_brilliance: parallel hypothesis scoring and simulation, not a physics claim
symbolic_compression.morpheus: operator persona for terminal bridge and pattern translation
symbolic_compression.core_roots: workspace, repo, logs, config, scripts, database, proof
symbolic_compression.binary_connection: executable commands, JSON configs, CLI outputs, hashes, and state rows
symbolic_compression.prime_agent: controlled master router that coordinates specialist lanes

resource_score_formula: (impact * confidence * urgency * available_compute) - (risk + complexity + cost + heat_or_context_switch_penalty)
